Here you will finish the code for the function studio9_problem_2(true_theta, n).

The arguments to this function are:

  • true_theta = the true proportion of the population who prefer Lincoln.
  • n = the number of people polled.

Here we imagine taking a poll in 1860 to find out the the fraction of Massachusetts residents who support Lincoln. The argument true_theta is the true proportion supporting Lincoln.

The function should simulate (using true_theta) polling n people. It should then compute and print out the rule-of-thumb 95% confidence interval. Print this out as an estimated proportion plus or minus a margin of error.

翻译: 按真实支持率模拟 n 人民调, 用样本支持率估计 θ, 输出「估计值 ± 误差范围」的经验 95% 区间.

思路: 每人是否支持 Lincoln 是 Bernoulli 变量. 经验误差范围为 1/n​, 来自 20.25/n​, 用最大方差 p(1−p)≤1/4 作保守近似.

答案 (先自己做再看) 
studio9_problem_2 = function(true_theta, n) {
  data = rbinom(n, 1, true_theta)
  estimated_theta = mean(data)
  margin_of_error = 1/sqrt(n)

  cat('Confidence interval: ', estimated_theta, 'plus or minus', margin_of_error, '\n')
}

测试以真实支持率 0.55 调查 400 人, 得到样本支持率 0.52, 误差范围 1/400​=0.05. 输出为 0.52 plus or minus 0.05.

样本支持率和区间会随随机民调变化, 误差范围在固定 n 下不变.

R Studio 10 · Bootstrap 置信区间
Studio 10 Bootstrap confidence intervals对应 MIT1805 24;源文件 mit18_05_s22_studio10-instructions.pdf, mit18_05_s22_studio10-solutions.r, mit18_05_s22_studio10.zip;内容: percentile/basic 区间、覆盖率模拟与对数正态分布.

实践目标与区间构造
Overview and bootstrap construction

Studio 10 · Page 1

This studio simulates bootstrap confidence intervals type I error rates. We can use the simulations to estimate the true confidence (1− type I CI error rate) of bootstrip intervals with a given nominal confidence. We will also compare the performance of the percentile and basic methods.

Here is a little more detail on what we are hoping to do.

  1. We know that a 95% confidence intervals has the following meaning: If 1000 labs each ran an experiment and used their data to make a 95% CI for the mean (or any parameter) then we would expect about 95% of the intervals to contain the true value, i.e. there should be about a 5% type I CI error rate
  2. In real life you can never actually check the error rate because you don’t know the true value
  3. The bootstrap CI is this weird construction. Calling it a 95% CI is plausible, but we can check if it truly is a 95% CI by simulation, where, unlike in real life, we do know the true value of the mean (or other quantity)

We will do these simulations for two distributions.

  1. Standard normal distribution. This is symmetric and well behaved.
  2. Log-normal distribution. This is highly skewed and certain statistics will give the bootstrap some trouble.

标称 95% 的 Bootstrap 区间不保证恰好有 95% 的真实覆盖率. 这次从已知总体反复生成原始样本, 对每个样本构造区间, 再统计真值不在区间内的比例.

percentile 直接取 Bootstrap 统计量分布的两个分位数. basic 使用 pivot 反转: 若估计值为 θ^, 区间为

(2θ^−q1−α/2∗​,2θ^−qα/2∗​),

其中 qp∗​ 是 Bootstrap 统计量的第 p 分位数. 解答用 θ∗−θ^ 和反向分位数实现同一公式.

原文笔误: Overview 的 bootstrip 应为 bootstrap; Summary 的「simulated 1 CI error rate」漏了 type; Problem 2a 的「values for of the mean」应删去 for.

统一计算六种 Bootstrap 区间
Utility functions. Percentile and basic intervals

Studio 10 · Utility functions · Solutions

Rather than copying and pasting code, we make use of some utility functions.

First solution: Use the package matrixStats for speed.

Return value: list of 12 values indicating 6 confidence intervals: c(mean_percentile_ci, median_percentile_ci, sd_percentile_ci, mean_basic_ci, median_basic_ci, sd_basic_ci). Each of the ci consists of two values: c(lower_bound, upper_bound).

翻译: 把同一套重抽样逻辑封装成函数, 一次返回均值、中位数、标准差的 percentile 和 basic 区间.

思路: 把所有 Bootstrap 样本放在矩阵里, 每列是一份重抽样. 用 colMeans2(), colMedians(), colSds() 一次算完每列统计量.

答案 (先自己做再看) 
library('matrixStats')

is_type1_error = function(trueval, ci) {
  if (trueval < ci[1] || trueval > ci[2]) { return(1) }
  else { return(0) }
}

run_bootstrap_matrixStats = function(x, n_boot, confidence) {
  n_data = length(x)
  alpha = 1.0 - confidence
  mean_hat = mean(x)
  median_hat = median(x)
  sd_hat = sd(x)

  xstar = sample(x, n_data*n_boot, replace=TRUE)
  xstar = matrix(xstar, nrow=n_data, ncol=n_boot)
  mean_star = colMeans2(xstar)
  median_star = colMedians(xstar)
  sd_star = colSds(xstar)

  p = c(alpha/2, 1-alpha/2)
  mean_percentile_ci = quantile(mean_star, p)
  median_percentile_ci = quantile(median_star, p)
  sd_percentile_ci = quantile(sd_star, p)

  p = c(1-alpha/2, alpha/2)
  mean_delta_star = mean_star - mean_hat
  mean_basic_ci = mean_hat - quantile(mean_delta_star, p)
  median_delta_star = median_star - median_hat
  median_basic_ci = median_hat - quantile(median_delta_star, p)
  sd_delta_star = sd_star - sd_hat
  sd_basic_ci = sd_hat - quantile(sd_delta_star, p)

  return(c(mean_percentile_ci, median_percentile_ci, sd_percentile_ci,
           mean_basic_ci, median_basic_ci, sd_basic_ci))
}

前 6 个返回值依次是三种 percentile 区间的上下限, 后 6 个是三种 basic 区间的上下限. is_type1_error() 只在真值小于下限或大于上限时返回 1.

不用 matrixStats 时, 也可以在每次循环中生成一份 xstar, 把 mean(xstar), median(xstar), sd(xstar) 存入向量. 两种写法的统计公式相同, 矩阵版主要优势是速度.

正态数据的 Bootstrap 覆盖率
Problem 1. Empirical bootstrap CI error rate: normal distribution

Studio 10 · Problem 1 · Pages 2–3

Here you will finish the code for the function studio10_problem_1(true_mean, true_sd, n_data, n_boot, n_trials, confidence).

The arguments to this function are:

  • true_mean = the mean of the normal distribution used to generate the data
  • true_sd = the standard deviation of the normal distribution used to generate the data
  • n_data = number of values in the original and each bootstrap sample
  • n_boot = number of bootstrap samples to use in each trial
  • n_trials = number of trials in the simulation
  • confidence = the bootstrap confidence level, e.g. 0.95, 0.9 etc

Your code will simulate finding empirical bootstrap type 1 CI error rates for the mean, median and standard deviation.

  1. Generate a normal sample of size n_data.
  2. Compute the statistics in question of the sample.
  3. From the original sample, generate n_boot empirical bootstrap samples.
  4. Using the bootstrap samples compute the empirical percentile and basic bootstrap confidence intervals with the given confidence.
  5. Using the known true value of the statistics in question, check for a type I CI error for each statistic.

From all the trials, report the type I CI error rate.

翻译: 重复生成正态原始样本并做 Bootstrap, 分别统计均值、中位数、标准差的两种区间未覆盖真值的频率.

思路: 正态分布的真实中位数等于真实均值. 每次调用统一的 run_bootstrap(), 把返回的 12 个端点拆成六个区间, 再累加六种错误计数.

答案 (先自己做再看) 
true_median = true_mean
mean_percentile_type1 = 0
median_percentile_type1 = 0
sd_percentile_type1 = 0
mean_basic_type1 = 0
median_basic_type1 = 0
sd_basic_type1 = 0

for (i in 1:n_trials) {
  data = rnorm(n_data, true_mean, true_sd)
  cis = run_bootstrap(data, n_boot, confidence)

  mean_percentile_ci = cis[1:2]
  median_percentile_ci = cis[3:4]
  sd_percentile_ci = cis[5:6]
  mean_basic_ci = cis[7:8]
  median_basic_ci = cis[9:10]
  sd_basic_ci = cis[11:12]

  mean_percentile_type1 = mean_percentile_type1 + is_type1_error(true_mean, mean_percentile_ci)
  median_percentile_type1 = median_percentile_type1 + is_type1_error(true_median, median_percentile_ci)
  sd_percentile_type1 = sd_percentile_type1 + is_type1_error(true_sd, sd_percentile_ci)
  mean_basic_type1 = mean_basic_type1 + is_type1_error(true_mean, mean_basic_ci)
  median_basic_type1 = median_basic_type1 + is_type1_error(true_median, median_basic_ci)
  sd_basic_type1 = sd_basic_type1 + is_type1_error(true_sd, sd_basic_ci)
}

cat('Type 1 error rates (percentile, basic):\n')
cat('mean:', mean_percentile_type1/n_trials, mean_basic_type1/n_trials, '\n')
cat('median:', median_percentile_type1/n_trials, median_basic_type1/n_trials, '\n')
cat('sd:', sd_percentile_type1/n_trials, sd_basic_type1/n_trials, '\n')

两组测试输出如下. 每格依次是 percentile、basic 的错误率.

参数与标称水平均值中位数标准差
μ=0,σ=1,n=400,B=500, 95%0.058 / 0.0580.042 / 0.0840.060 / 0.050
μ=1,σ=1.5,n=200,B=1000, 90%0.103 / 0.09850.082 / 0.15850.111 / 0.107

均值区间接近标称错误率, 但中位数的 basic 区间在这两次模拟中偏差更明显. 标称置信水平不是每种统计量和构造法都能自动达到的保证.

对数正态的真实均值、中位数和标准差
Problem 2a. Log-normal parameters and moments

Studio 10 · Problem 2a · Page 3

Here you will finish the code for the function studio10_problem_2a(meanlog, sdlog).

The arguments to this function are:

  • meanlog = value of meanlog parameter in rlnorm
  • sdlog = value of sdlog parameter in rlnorm

Go to the Wikipedia page and find the formulas for the mean, median and standard deviation of the log-normal distribution in terms of the parameters to the R function rlnorm.

Your solution should implement these formulas and print out the values for of the mean, median and standard deviation for the given meanlog and sdlog.

翻译: 用 rlnorm() 的参数 meanlog 和 sdlog 计算对数正态分布本身的均值、中位数和标准差.

思路: 若 logX∼N(μ,σ2), 则

E[X]=eμ+σ2/2,median(X)=eμ,
sd(X)=(eσ2−1)e2μ+σ2​.

这里的 μ,σ 是 log 之后正态分布的参数, 不是 X 本身的均值和标准差.

答案 (先自己做再看) 
studio10_problem_2a = function(meanlog, sdlog) {
  true_mean = exp(meanlog + sdlog^2/2)
  true_median = exp(meanlog)
  true_sd = sqrt((exp(sdlog^2)-1)*exp(2*meanlog+sdlog^2))

  s = sprintf('LogNormal: meanlog=%.1f, sdlog=%.1f', meanlog, sdlog)
  cat(s,'\n')
  s = sprintf('Distribution mean=%.2f, median=%.2f, std dev=%.2f', true_mean, true_median, true_sd)
  cat(s,'\n')
}
meanlogsdlog真实均值真实中位数真实标准差
011.651.002.16
027.391.0054.10
−31.50.150.050.45
−210.220.140.29

对数正态右偏, 均值大于中位数. sdlog 增大时, 右尾会迅速拉高均值和标准差.

对数正态数据的 Bootstrap 覆盖率
Problem 2b. Empirical bootstrap CI error rate: log-normal distribution

Studio 10 · Problem 2b · Page 3

Here you will finish the code for the function studio10_problem_2b(meanlog, sdlog, n_data, n_boot, n_trials, confidence).

The arguments to this function are:

  • meanlog = value of meanlog parameter in rlnorm
  • sdlog = value of sdlog parameter in rlnorm
  • n_data = number of values in each sample
  • n_boot = number of bootstrap samples to use in each trial
  • n_trials = number of trials in the simulation
  • confidence = the bootstrap confidence level

Repeat problem 1 using the log-normal instead of the normal distribution (R: rlnorm()). Use the given meanlog and sdlog values as the parameters to rlnorm.

翻译: 把 Problem 1 的总体换成对数正态, 再检查六种区间的真实错误率.

思路: 代码结构不变, 只把 rnorm() 换成 rlnorm(), 并用 2a 的三个公式计算真值. 重点比较偏态对均值、中位数和标准差覆盖率的影响.

答案 (先自己做再看) 
true_mean = exp(meanlog + sdlog^2/2)
true_median = exp(meanlog)
true_sd = sqrt((exp(sdlog^2)-1)*exp(2*meanlog+sdlog^2))

for (i in 1:n_trials) {
  data = rlnorm(n_data, meanlog=meanlog, sdlog=sdlog)
  cis = run_bootstrap(data, n_boot, confidence)

  mean_percentile_type1 = mean_percentile_type1 + is_type1_error(true_mean, cis[1:2])
  median_percentile_type1 = median_percentile_type1 + is_type1_error(true_median, cis[3:4])
  sd_percentile_type1 = sd_percentile_type1 + is_type1_error(true_sd, cis[5:6])
  mean_basic_type1 = mean_basic_type1 + is_type1_error(true_mean, cis[7:8])
  median_basic_type1 = median_basic_type1 + is_type1_error(true_median, cis[9:10])
  sd_basic_type1 = sd_basic_type1 + is_type1_error(true_sd, cis[11:12])
}

测试输出仍按「percentile / basic」排列:

参数与标称水平均值中位数标准差
meanlog 0, sdlog 1, n=100,B=500, 95%0.090 / 0.1090.068 / 0.1030.321 / 0.309
meanlog −3, sdlog 1.5, n=50,B=2000, 90%0.228 / 0.2610.096 / 0.2150.682 / 0.656
meanlog −2, sdlog 1, n=200,B=600, 80%0.214 / 0.2080.205 / 0.2730.391 / 0.406

偏态越强, 覆盖率问题越突出, 尤其标准差区间. 第二组标称 90% 的 sd 区间错误率超过 0.65, 说明它远没有 90% 的真实覆盖. 增加 Bootstrap 重抽样次数只能减小 Monte Carlo 误差, 不能修复原始样本偏态和统计量分布带来的方法偏差.

R 小测练习 · 综合编程
R Quiz Practice对应 MIT1805 01–24;源文件 mit18_05_s22_rquizpractice-instructions.pdf, mit18_05_s22_rquizpractice-solutions.r, mit18_05_s22_rquizpractice.zip;内容: R 基础、贝叶斯预测、计数、检验与模拟.

练习说明
Overview

R Quiz Practice · Page 1

These are practice questions for the quiz. The format is similiar to the R studios and will be identical to the R Quiz.

This is much longer than the actual quiz. As usual, you should read and follow all instructions.

You should be sure to look at problem 7, which is about looking up how to do something on Google.

这套练习比正式小测长, 用来综合检查 R 编程. 前 6 题覆盖前面学过的抽样、画图、统计量、贝叶斯更新、检验和模拟, 第 7 题要求查 R 帮助解决新方法.

清理环境可用 rm(list=ls()), 清空 RStudio 控制台可用 cat("\014"). 这两行只影响 R 工作区和显示, 不改变统计计算.

原文笔误: Overview 的 similiar 应为 similar; General instructions 的 soure 应为 source.

R 基础、统计量与常用检验
Problem 1. Basics

R Quiz Practice · Problem 1a–1h · Pages 2–4

1a. Generate and print a sample of size n_samples from a normal distribution with mean mu and standard deviation sigma.

1b. Generate and print a sample of size n_samples from a Binomial(size, theta) distribution.

1c. Generate n_samples with replacement from the list given by sample_space. Print the result.

1d. Use the sample function to generate a permutation of the numbers 1 to n. Print the result.

1e. Plot the graph of sin(w∗x) over the interval 0 to x_1. Add the graph of cos(w∗x) in a different color. Add a vertical line at x=0 and a horizontal line at y=0.

1f. Generate n_samples independent values from a Uniform(a,b) distribution. Compute and print the sample mean, median, variance, standard deviation and first and third quartiles of this data.

1g. Generate arrays x and y: each of them should have n_samples independent values from a Uniform(a,b) distribution. Let z = (x + y)/2. Compute the sample covariance and correlation of x and z. Print the results. Make a scatter plot of y vs x.

1h. Generate x1 and x2: both samples of size n_samples from normal distributions. x_1 should be from a Norm(mu1, sigma1) and x_2 should be from a Norm(mu2, sigma2). Print out all the arguments to this function.

1h(i) Run a z-test with null hypothesis H0​: x_1 is drawn from a normal distribution with mean mu0 and known variance sigma0. Make the test two-sided. Use signifcance level alpha. Print out the z-statistic, p-value and the conclusion of the test.

1h(ii) Run a t-test with null hypothesis H0​: x_1 is drawn from a normal distribution with mean mu0 and unknown variance. Make the test two-sided. Use signifcance level alpha. You can use the R function t.test(). Print the t-statistic, p-value and the conclusion of the test.

1h(iii) Test whether x_1 and x_2 are drawn from normal distributions with the same mean. Make the test two-sided. Assume equal variances. Use significance level alpha. Print the t-statistic, p-value and the conclusion of the test.

1h(iv) Test whether x_1 and x_2 are drawn from normal distributions with the same variance. Use significance level alpha. Print the test statistic, p-value and the conclusion of the test.

翻译: 1a–1d 是四种基本抽样; 1e 画三角函数; 1f 求样本统计量; 1g 研究 x 与平均值 z=(x+y)/2 的协方差和相关; 1h 分别做 z、单样本 t、双样本 t 和方差 F 检验.

思路: 分布随机数用 rnorm(), rbinom(), runif(); 任意列表抽样用 sample(). 双样本均值检验写明 var.equal=TRUE, 方差比较用 var.test().

答案 (先自己做再看)

1a–1d. 二项函数的参数顺序是「生成个数、每次实验次数、成功概率」. 排列要求不放回.

x = rnorm(n_samples, mu, sigma)
cat(x, '\n')
x = rbinom(n_samples, size, theta)
cat(x, '\n')
x = sample(sample_space, n_samples, replace=TRUE)
cat(x, '\n')
x = sample(1:n, n, replace=FALSE)
cat(x, '\n')

1e. 先建立密集横坐标, 再分别计算 sin 和 cos. lines() 把第二条曲线加到当前图.

x = seq(0, x_1, 0.01)
y = sin(w*x)
plot(x, y, type='l', col='blue', lwd=1.5)
y = cos(w*x)
lines(x, y, col='orange', lwd=1.5)
abline(v=0)
abline(h=0)
title("Plot for problem 1e")

1f. quantile() 可一次传入多个概率.

x = runif(n_samples, a, b)
m = mean(x)
med = median(x)
v = var(x)
std_dev = sqrt(v)
q = quantile(x, c(0.25, 0.75))
cat("mean:", m, '\n')
cat("median:", med, '\n')
cat("var:", v, '\n')
cat("sd:", std_dev, '\n')
cat("0.25 and 0.75 quantiles for the data:", q, '\n')

测试的 5000 个 Uniform(1,5) 样本给出均值 3.010489、中位数 3.002567、方差 1.293794、标准差 1.137451, 两个四分位数为 2.045466 和 3.991788.

1g. 理论上 Cov(X,Z)=Var(X)/2, Cor(X,Z)=1/2​. 样本结果会在这附近波动.

x = runif(n_samples, a, b)
y = runif(n_samples, a, b)
z = (x+y)/2
cv = cov(x, z)
cr = cor(x, z)
cat('Covariance of x and z:', cv, '\n')
cat('Correlation of x and z:', cr, '\n')
plot(x, y, col='blue', pch=19, cex=0.5)
title("Scatterplot for problem 1g")

测试的 50 对样本给出协方差 0.1393713、相关系数 0.6616549. 散点图画的是 x 与 y, 不是 x 与 z.

1h(i). z 检验使用已知标准差 sigma0:

xbar = mean(x1)
z_stat = (xbar - mu0)/(sigma0/sqrt(n_samples))
p_value = 2*(1 - pnorm(abs(z_stat),0,1))

1h(ii)–(iv). 三个内置检验分别返回统计量和 p 值:

result = t.test(x1, mu=mu0, conf.level=1-alpha)
t_stat = result$statistic
p_value = result$p.value

result = t.test(x1, x2, var.equal=TRUE, conf.level=1-alpha)
t_stat = result$statistic
p_value = result$p.value

result = var.test(x1, x2)
test_stat = result$statistic
p_value = result$p.value

三组测试展示了不同模型下的结果:

生成参数z p 值单样本 t p 值双样本 t p 值方差 F p 值
μ1​=0,σ1​=2;μ2​=1.5,σ2​=20.36940.37322.04×10−6, 拒绝0.5816
μ1​=0,σ1​=2;μ2​=0,σ2​=20.079690.03781, 拒绝0.054640.04386, 拒绝
μ1​=1,σ1​=5;μ2​=1.5,σ2​=20.0005056, 拒绝0.21320.97371.17×10−13, 拒绝

同一个 z/t 或均值/方差问题可能因模型假设不同而得到不同结论. 特别是双样本 t 检验这里被要求假设等方差, 第三组生成数据实际上并不满足.

原文笔误: 1h 参数说明把 sigma1, sigma2 写成 sigm1, sigm2; 1h(i) 说 known variance sigma0, 但代码把它当标准差使用, 应改为 known standard deviation. 1g 输出中的「x an z」应为「x and z」.

贝叶斯更新与后验预测
Problem 2. Bayesian update simulation

R Quiz Practice · Problem 2 · Page 4

Here you will finish the code for the function rquiz_practice_problem_2(prior, next_roll).

Arguments:

  • prior = prior probability for the dice choices (5 numbers, usual order)
  • next_roll = the problem asks for the posterior predictive probability of rolling next_roll on the next roll.

Run a complete simulation of randomly choosing a die from our standard Platonic dice (4, 6, 8, 12, and 20 sided) based on the given prior. Then rolling it once and updating to a posterior probability for the type of die chosen.

Print out the prior, chosen die, roll and posterior.

Compute and print out the posterior predictive probability of rolling next_roll on the next roll.

翻译: 按先验选骰子并掷一次, 更新五种骰子的后验, 再计算下一次掷出指定点数的后验预测概率.

思路: 第一次结果用于贝叶斯更新. 预测下一次时, 对每种骰子用「后验 × 该骰子掷出目标点数的概率」再求和.

答案 (先自己做再看) 
dice = c(4,6,8,12,20)
chosen_die = sample(dice, 1, prob=prior)
roll = sample(1:chosen_die, 1)
likelihood = standard_likelihood_table[,roll]
bayes_numerator = prior*likelihood
posterior = bayes_numerator/sum(bayes_numerator)

likelihood_next = standard_likelihood_table[,next_roll]
post_predictive_prob = sum(posterior*likelihood_next)

cat('prior =', prior,'\n')
cat('chosen die =', chosen_die, '\n')
cat('roll =', roll, '\n')
cat('posterior =', posterior, '\n')
cat("Posterior prediction: P(", next_roll, "| data) =", post_predictive_prob, '\n')

测试先验均为 c(0.4,0.2,0.2,0.1,0.1). 一次模拟选中 D6 并掷出 5, 后验为

0, 0.4651163, 0.3488372, 0.1162791, 0.06976744

下一次掷出 4 的预测概率为 ∑i​P(Di​∣data)/di​=0.1343023.

另一次模拟选中 D4 并掷出 3, 后验为 0.5825243, 0.1941748, 0.1456311, 0.04854369, 0.02912621. 下一次掷出 12 只有 D12、D20 可能, 预测概率为 0.005501618.

左右手戴戒指的计数
Problem 3. Counting Brass Rats

R Quiz Practice · Problem 3a–3b · Page 5

3a. On the morning of his platform speech, Tim the Beaver is deciding which Brass Rats to wear. They will wear 2 Brass Rats, one on their left hand, and one on their right hand. They have n_rats Brass Rats to choose from. How many ways can Tim wear two of their Brass Rats? (Order matters)

Compute and print out the number of ways Tim can wear their rings.

3b. How many Brass Rats would Tim hypothetically need for the number of possibilities to be over n_ways? Use a for loop or any other efficient means.

翻译: 从 n 个戒指中选两个分别戴左手和右手, 左右位置有区别. 反求至少需要多少戒指, 才能让佩戴方式达到指定数量.

思路: 有序选两个是 P(n,2)=2(2n​)=n(n−1). 从 2 开始递增, 找到第一个达到要求数量的 n.

答案 (先自己做再看) 
rquiz_practice_problem_3a = function(n_rats) {
  n = choose(n_rats, 2)*2
  cat(n_rats, 'rings can be worn', n, 'different ways\n')
}

rquiz_practice_problem_3b = function(n_ways) {
  n = 2
  while(TRUE) {
    ans = choose(n,2)*2
    if (ans >= n_ways) { break }
    n = n+1
  }
  cat('They would need at least', n, 'Brass rats.\n')
}

3 个戒指有 3×2=6 种, 4 个有 4×3=12 种. 要至少 30000 种时, 173×172=29756 不够, 174×173=30102 首次达到, 所以答案是 174.

原文笔误: 3b 的「over n_ways」若按字面是严格大于, 解答实现的是大于或等于 n_ways. 题目应改为「at least n_ways」或「at least n_ways ways」.

支持率分布与左尾检验
Problem 4. Polling

R Quiz Practice · Problem 4a–4b · Pages 5–6

In past years fraction of students supporting Tim has been theta_tim. An 18.05 student runs a poll to see if that support has dropped. They poll n_students MIT students.

4a. The number of students who support Tim follows a certain distribution. Plot this distribution.

4b. To test the conjecture that Tim’s support has dropped below theta_H0, they run a significance test. For the test, use the data given: n_support and significance level alpha. Print the null and alternative hypotheses. Print the rejection region, p-value and the conclusion of the test.

翻译: 支持人数服从 Binomial(n,θ). 先画 pmf, 再检验 H0​:θ=0.7 对 HA​:θ<0.7, 使用左尾拒绝域.

思路: 左尾临界值用 qbinom(alpha,n,theta_H0)-1. 观测到 x 名支持者时, 左尾 p 值是 P(X≤x∣H0​).

答案 (先自己做再看) 
x = 0:n_students
y = dbinom(x, n_students, theta_tim)
plot(x, y, type='p', pch=20, cex=0.6, col='blue')
title("Plot for 4a")

left_critical_point = qbinom(alpha, n_students, theta_H0) - 1
cat('rejection region: (left tail): x <=',left_critical_point, '\n')
p_value = pbinom(n_support_tim, n_students, theta_H0)
cat("p =", p_value,'\n')
if (p_value < alpha) { cat('Reject H0','\n') }
else { cat('Do not reject H0','\n') }

当 n=200,θ0​=0.7,α=0.05 时, 拒绝域为 x≤128.

  • 观测 129 人: p=0.05420741>0.05, 不拒绝 H0.
  • 观测 128 人: p=0.03962828<0.05, 拒绝 H0.

拒绝域边界和 p 值判断一致: 129 在边界外, 128 在边界内.

原文笔误: 4b 的参数说明把 n_support_tim 写成 n_support, 把 theta_H0 (最后是数字 0) 写成 theta_HO (最后是字母 O); 代码应以函数签名为准.

指数分布与直方图
Problem 5. Simulation of exponential data

R Quiz Practice · Problem 5a–5b · Page 6

Hack the Hawk takes the Number 1 Bus to commute to MIT’s campus. The 1 Bus is known to be late by Y minutes, where Y follows an exponential distribution with lamba = 0.2 (units of 1/minutes).

5a. Plot the pdf of Exp(lambda). Use the range 0 to 4/lambda.

5b. Simulate the lateness of the bus over n_bus_trips days.

5b(i) Plot a frequency histogram of the simulated data. Use bin_width of 1.0.

5b(i) Plot a density histogram of the simulated data. Use bin_width of 1.0. Add a plot of the pdf for Exponential(lambda).

翻译: 公交晚点服从速率 λ 的指数分布. 先在 [0,4/λ] 画 pdf, 再模拟多次晚点并画频率、密度直方图.

思路: 用 dexp() 算理论密度, rexp() 生成数据. 两张直方图使用同一组分箱, 便于只比较纵轴含义.

答案 (先自己做再看) 
x = seq(0, 4/lambda, 0.001)
pdf_Y = dexp(x, rate = lambda)
plot(x,pdf_Y,type = 'l', col='blue', lwd=1.5)
title("Plot for problem 5a")

data = rexp(n_bus_trips, lambda)
bin_width = 1.0
bins = seq(min(data), max(data)+bin_width, bin_width)

hist(data, breaks=bins, col='yellow', freq=TRUE, main="")
title("Problem 5b(i): frequency histogram of data")

hist(data, breaks=bins, col='yellow', freq=FALSE, main="")
x = seq(0, max(bins), 0.01)
y = dexp(x, lambda)
lines(x, y, col='blue', lwd=2)
title("Problem 5b(ii): density histogram of data")

原文笔误: Problem 5b 的两个小问都编号为 5b(i), 第二个应为 5b(ii). 场景段的 lamba 应为 lambda.

赌博收益的均值、方差与正态近似
Problem 6. Gambling: theory and simulation

R Quiz Practice · Problem 6a–6b · Pages 6–7

Punt plays roulette at a nearby casino. She plays 10 times every day, for 7 days. She bets on red each time. (The roulette wheel has 18 red, 18 black, and 2 green slots)

If she loses, her loss is $1. If she wins her gain is $1.

6a. Compute and print the expected value and variance of one bet. Compute and print out the expected value and variance one day’s winnings. Compute and print out the expected value and variance n_days winnings.

6b(i) Write R code to simulate Punt’s total earnings for n_days. Run n_trials trials and plot the density histogram of the results. Add a graph of the normal curve which approximates this histogram.

6b(ii) Explain why the normal distribution used in 6b(i) approximates the density.

翻译: 每局押红收益为 +1 或 −1. 先算单局、每天和多天的理论均值与方差, 再模拟多天总收益并用正态曲线近似.

思路: 独立同分布求和时, 均值和方差都按局数相加. 总收益是很多独立单局收益之和, 因此可用 CLT.

答案 (先自己做再看) 
one_bet_values = c(1,-1)
one_bet_prob = c(18/38,20/38)
one_bet_mu = sum(one_bet_values*one_bet_prob)
one_bet_var = sum((one_bet_values-one_bet_mu)^2*one_bet_prob)

one_day_mu = n_bets_per_day*one_bet_mu
one_day_var = n_bets_per_day*one_bet_var
n_days_mu = n_days*one_day_mu
n_days_var = n_days*one_day_var

单局均值为 −1/19≈−0.05263158, 方差为 360/361≈0.9972299. 每天 40 局时, 均值为 −2.105263、方差为 39.8892; 7 天共 280 局时, 均值为 −14.73684、方差为 279.2244.

n_bets_per_trial = n_bets_per_day * n_days
x = sample(one_bet_values, n_bets_per_trial*n_trials,
           prob=one_bet_prob, replace=TRUE)
trials = matrix(x, nrow=n_bets_per_trial, ncol=n_trials)
n_days_winnings = colSums(trials)
hist(n_days_winnings, freq=FALSE, col='orange', breaks=n_bets_per_day, main="")

mu_sum = n_bets_per_trial*one_bet_mu
sigma_sum = sqrt(n_bets_per_trial*one_bet_var)
x = seq(mu_sum-4*sigma_sum, mu_sum+4*sigma_sum, 0.01)
y = dnorm(x, mu_sum, sigma_sum)
lines(x, y, col='blue', lwd=2)

每列是一次完整的多天试验. 正态曲线的均值取 Nμ, 标准差取 Nσ2​, 其中 N 是总投注局数. CLT 解释了为什么大量独立局数求和后近似正态.

原文笔误: 解答文件 6a 的最后一条输出写成「Expected variance of 7 winnings in =」, 语序错误; 应为「Variance of winnings in 7 days =」.

用 Wilcoxon 秩和检验比较两校成绩
Problem 7. Using Google

R Quiz Practice · Problem 7 · Page 7

MIT challenged Harvard to a race to determine which school had, on average, faster runners. Both schools chose some random students and excused them from finals to run the race.

After the race you were called in to analyze the data. Unfortunately, the statistics professors at both schools were gone and the only instruction they had left was to use the Wilcoxon Rank Sum test to see if the mean ranks were the same.

Figure out how to do this in R and write code that expects two vectors of data mit_times and harvard_times containing the finishing time for the students who raced.

Your code should run the Wilcoxon Rank Sum test and print:

  1. the test statistic,
  2. which if either school appears faster on average,
  3. the p_value of the test.

You may use any function you can find in R.

翻译: 用 Wilcoxon rank sum test 比较两校学生的完赛时间秩次, 输出统计量、p 值, 并根据样本时间判断哪所学校看起来更快.

思路: 双独立样本用 wilcox.test(x,y,alternative="two.sided"). 时间越短表示越快. 检验针对秩次/分布位置, 不是直接检验均值.

答案 (先自己做再看) 
result = wilcox.test(mit_times, harvard_times, alternative="two.sided")
p_value = result$p.value
stat = result$statistic

mit_median = median(mit_times)
harvard_median = median(harvard_times)
cat('test stat =', stat,'\n')
cat('p_value =', p_value, '\n')
if (p_value < alpha) {
  if (mit_median < harvard_median) {
    cat('MIT appears to be the faster school.\n')
  } else {
    cat('MIT appears to be the slower school.\n')
  }
} else {
  cat('Do not reject H0. The test cannot distinguish the two schools.\n')
}

测试固定随机种子, 各生成 25 个时间. MIT 和 Harvard 的样本中位数分别为 16.55937 和 17.70343, 统计量 W=208, p=0.04289115<0.05. 拒绝两组位置相同的原假设; MIT 的样本时间更短, 因此看起来更快.

原文概念不严谨: 解答把 H0/HA 直接写成「两组中位数相同/不同」, 又说检验哪组「on average」更快. Wilcoxon 秩和检验比较的是秩次和分布位置, 并不单独检验均值或中位数; 在位置平移模型下才可解释为位置差. 上面按秩次检验表述, 样本中位数只用于描述方向.

R 小测 · 综合检验
R Quiz对应 MIT1805 01–24;源文件 mit18_05_s22_rquiz-instructions.pdf, mit18_05_s22_rquiz-solutions.r, mit18_05_s22_rquiz.zip;内容: 分布图、贝叶斯更新、CLT、Shapiro–Wilk 与 Welch t 检验.

小测说明
Overview

R Quiz · Page 1

The quiz format is identical to that of the R studios and practice quiz.

  • Read the problems carefully.
  • Save your work frequently.
  • You may use any resources except another person.
  • If code is given with a question it is meant to be used. Don’t just ignore it.
  • Remember to use print or cat statements to print the values asked for.
  • Make sure that it runs without error and outputs just the answers asked for in the questions.

正式小测仍是补全函数的格式. 先保留题目给出的参数和输出结构, 只写要求的计算与打印. 开始前的 rm(list=ls()) 用来清空工作区, cat('\014') 用来清空控制台.

R 的许多检验结果都可用 result$p.value 和 result$statistic 取出, 不要把屏幕上看到的 p 值手工写死.

分布图、组合数与贝叶斯成功概率
Problem 1. Graphs, combinations and Bayesian success

R Quiz · Problem 1a–1c · 20 points

1a (5 points) Graphing. On the same plot for x between a and b put graphs of the pdfs of: (i) Norm(mu, sigma); (ii) Weibull distribution with shape and scale parameters w_shape and w_scale. The graphs should be in different colors. Every plot should be a line graph (type='l').

1b (5 points) Combination and factorials. This function should compute and print the following values: (i) n choose k; (ii) m factorial; (iii) log of n choose k (for this use the function lchoose to avoid overflow).

1c (10 points) Bayesian success. A treatment with unknown probability θ of success is tried on num_patients patients yielding num_cured successes. The possible values of the unknown θ are given in theta_values. That is, we only entertain a finite number of hypotheses for the value of θ.

Your code should use the data and do each of the following:

  1. Compute the maximum likelihood estimate (MLE) for θ. Print out the MLE.
  2. Suppose there is a flat prior, i.e. each of the possible values of θ is equally likely. Find the prior predictive probability that a single patient will be cured. Print out the predictive probability. (This part does not use the experimental data.)
  3. Use the data and a flat prior to do a Bayesian update to find the posterior probability for θ. Print out the posterior.

翻译: 1a 在同图画正态和 Weibull 密度; 1b 计算组合数、阶乘和组合数的对数; 1c 在有限个 θ 假设下求 MLE、单患者治愈的先验预测概率和全数据后的后验.

思路: 1c(i) 对全部候选值计算二项似然并取最大位置. 1c(ii) 在均匀先验下, 预测概率就是候选 θ 的平均. 1c(iii) 仍是先验乘似然后归一化.

答案 (先自己做再看)

1a. 先用两条密度的最大值确定纵轴范围, 再用不同颜色画线.

lwd = 2
x = seq(a, b, 0.001)
y1 = dnorm(x, mu, sigma)
y2 = dweibull(x, shape=w_shape, scale=w_scale)
m = max(y1,y2)
plot(c(a,b), c(0,m), type='n', xlab='x', ylab='')
lines(x, y1, col='orange', lwd=lwd)
lines(x, y2, col='blue', lwd=lwd)
title('Problem 1a: various graphs')

1b. choose() 和 factorial() 在大输入下可能溢出, lchoose() 直接计算对数组合数.

x1 = choose(n, k)
cat('choose(', n, ', ', k, ') = ', x1, '\n', sep='')
x2 = factorial(m)
cat(m, '! = ', x2, '\n', sep='')
x3 = lchoose(n, k)
cat('lchoose(', n, ', ', k, ') = ', x3, '\n', sep='')

测试一: (618​)=18564, 14!=87178291200, log(618​)=9.82898. 测试二: choose(10000,1201) 在双精度下显示为 Inf, 55!≈1.26964×1073, 但 lchoose(10000,1201) 仍给出 3666.841.

1c. 

likelihoods = dbinom(num_cured, num_patients, theta_values)
max_ind = which.max(likelihoods)
mle = theta_values[max_ind]

prior = rep(1,length(theta_values))/length(theta_values)
likelihoods = dbinom(1, 1, theta_values)
total_prob = sum(prior*likelihoods)

likelihoods_data = dbinom(num_cured, num_patients, theta_values)
bayse_numerator = likelihoods_data*prior
posterior = bayse_numerator/sum(bayse_numerator)
print(cbind(theta_values, posterior), digits=7)
候选值与数据MLE先验预测后验
0.1, 0.4, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9; 200 人 78 成功0.40.523.3039×10−26, 0.9921397, 0.007860349, 1.6900×10−18, 3.4069×10−68
0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1.0; 50 人 38 成功0.80.70.000001801448, 0.06823300, 0.9317652, 0

第二组候选里有 θ=1, 但只出现 38/50 成功, 所以它的似然为 0. MLE 只看哪个候选似然最大, 后验还受均匀先验和全部候选归一化影响.

原文记号不一致: 1a 写 Norm(mu, sigma), 但函数参数和 dnorm() 都把 sigma 当标准差; 按本课通常写法应为 N(μ,σ2).

卡方样本与标准化均值
Problem 2. Histograms

R Quiz · Problem 2a–2b · 20 points

2a (10 points). Your code should simulate n_draws draws from a chi-square distribution with k degrees of freedom. Use the results to plot a density histogram. Use a bin width of bin_width. Finally, plot the χ2(k) probability density function on top of it.

2b (10 points). This problem will illustrate the central limit theorem as follows.

  • One trial will consist of drawing a sample of size n_draws from a χ2(k) distribution.
  • Simulate n_trials trials.
  • For each trial, compute the standardized mean. It should help to know that the χ2(k) distribution has mean k and variance 2k.
  • Plot a density histogram of the n_trials standardized means. Use bin width bin_width.
  • Add a graph of the standard normal pdf to the histogram.

翻译: 2a 比较卡方样本直方图与理论 pdf. 2b 重复抽取卡方样本, 标准化每次的样本均值, 再看它们是否接近标准正态.

思路: χ2(k) 的均值为 k, 方差为 2k. 样本均值的标准化是 (Xˉ−k)/2k/n​.

答案 (先自己做再看)

2a. 

mylightorange = rgb(1, 0.85, 0.41)
sim_data = rchisq(n_draws, k)
breaks = seq(0, max(sim_data)+bin_width, bin_width)
hist(sim_data, breaks=breaks, freq=FALSE, col=mylightorange, main='')
x = seq(0, max(sim_data), 0.01)
y = dchisq(x, k)
lines(x, y, col='blue', lwd=2.2)
title('Problem 2a: chi square data')

测试分别使用 df = 10 和 df = 30, 各 1000 个样本. df 越大, 卡方分布越对称、越集中.

2b. 

sample_means = rep(NA, n_trials)
for (j in 1:n_trials) {
  data = rchisq(n_draws, k)
  sample_means[j] = mean(data)
}
mu = k
sigma = sqrt(2*k)
standardized_means = (sample_means - mu)/(sigma/sqrt(n_draws))
minm = min(standardized_means)
maxm = max(standardized_means)
breaks = seq(minm, maxm+bin_width, bin_width)
hist(standardized_means, breaks=breaks, freq=FALSE, col=mylightorange, main='')
z = seq(minm, maxm, 0.01)
lines(z, dnorm(z), col='blue', lwd=2.2)
title('Problem 2b: standardized data')

测试取 k=2,n=100, 重复 10000 次. 单个 χ2(2) 很右偏, 但 100 个独立观测的均值标准化后已接近标准正态, 体现 CLT.

Shapiro–Wilk 正态性检验
Problem 3. Shapiro-Wilk test

R Quiz · Problem 3 · 10 points

You have collected data and before running a t-test, you want to check if the data comes from a normal distribution. To do this, you run a Shapiro-Wilk test for normality.

Run the Shapiro-Wilk test. Then, print out the null hypothesis, p-value and whether or not to reject the null hypothesis.

You need to use code to find and print the p-value and decide whether to reject or not. You shouldn’t just read the p-value off the screen and enter that value. That is, your code should work correctly even if we change the data or significance level for the test.

翻译: 用 Shapiro–Wilk 检查数据是否来自正态分布, 输出 H0、p 值和是否拒绝.

思路: H0 是「数据来自正态分布」. shapiro.test() 返回 p 值; p 小则拒绝正态性, p 大则不拒绝, 但不等于证明数据一定正态.

答案 (先自己做再看) 
rquiz_problem_3 = function(our_data, alpha) {
  res = shapiro.test(our_data)
  p_value = res$p.value
  cat('The null hypothesis H0 is that the data is from a normal distribution.', '\n')
  cat('p_value =', p_value, '\n')
  if (p_value > alpha) {
    cat('Do not reject H0. ','\n')
  } else {
    cat('Reject H0 in favor of HA that the data is not normal','\n')
  }
}

三组测试输出:

  • 200 个 N(3,42) 样本: p=0.9464181>0.05, 不拒绝 H0.
  • 200 个 t1​ 样本: p=4.470282×10−24<0.05, 拒绝 H0.
  • 30 个 t4​ 样本: p=0.0545889<0.1, 在 0.1 水平拒绝 H0.

第三组恰好在 0.05 之上但在 0.1 之下, 所以结论必须结合预先选定的 α 说明.

版本差异: 测试页的 Problem 3 仍把 H0 和 HA 显示为 <YOU NEED TO WRITE THIS>; 解答文件已补为「H0: 数据来自正态分布; HA: 数据不来自正态分布」. 上面按解答文件收录.

Welch 双样本 t 检验
Problem 4 (Extra credit). Two-sample t-test

R Quiz · Problem 4 · Extra credit 5 points

The lists are data from independent random normal trials.

The given code extracts two lists, x and y from the data file.

Run a two sample t-test with unequal variances to test if x and y are drawn from distributions with the same mean.

Print out the p-value and whether or not to reject the null hypothesis at significance level alpha.

You need to use code to find and print the p-value and decide whether to reject or not. You shouldn’t just read the p-value off the screen and enter that value. That is, your code should work correctly even if we change the data file or significance level for the test.

翻译: 两组独立正态数据, 在不要求方差相等的情况下检验均值是否相同, 输出 p 值和结论.

思路: 使用 Welch 版本: t.test(x,y,var.equal=FALSE). H0 是两组均值相同, HA 是不同.

答案 (先自己做再看) 
data = read.table(data_file_name)
x = data$x
y = data$y

res = t.test(x, y, alternative='two.sided', conf.level=1-alpha, var.equal=FALSE)
p = res$p.value
cat('p value =', p,'\n')
if (p > alpha) {
  cat('Do not reject H0 that the means are the same','\n')
} else {
  cat('Reject H0 in favor of HA that the means are different','\n')
}

测试数据每组 50 个值. 样本均值分别约为 0.04609 和 −0.06833, Welch 统计量 t=0.3605704, df 约为 70.05445, 双尾 p=0.7195056>0.05, 因此不拒绝均值相同的 H0.
